results.name: Two stable Viewer controls before opening a source
Opening take-1-1 replaces the source without accumulating tabs
Opening take-0-1 replaces the source without accumulating tabs
Opening take-1-2 replaces the source without accumulating tabs
Opening take-2-1 replaces the source without accumulating tabs
Timeline returns to its own cursor and clip selection
Returning to source preserves filename, cursor and In/Out
Reselecting the same source preserves its range and position
Source transport leaves Timeline cursor and its visible playhead in place
Insert uses selected source and In/Out at Timeline cursor, then activates Timeline
Undo restores original montage after source insertion
Title is visible in the Timeline viewer
Source viewer and Inspector do not inherit Timeline titles or title controls
Source viewer cannot transform the previously selected Timeline clip
Title selection and its Inspector return with Timeline
Capture stores the visible source and its time, with no Timeline edit
Scrubbing Timeline from source updates Viewer, switch and Inspector together
Source context keeps compact picker commands without a second navigation
Workspace round trip restores selected source and the same two viewer controls
Viewer labels are complete at 130 percent
Source In/Out and insertion are visible before metadata at 130 percent
Narrow Viewer protects controls and bounds the long source name
Both Viewer controls remain usable in the narrow layout
Very narrow Viewer moves filename below intact controls without overflow
Hiding panes does not change source or Timeline state
Source without a selected medium is visibly disabled
Audio source cannot move the Timeline through disabled video controls
